Spectator Following Rapunzel and the gang into the enchanted Woods

Saturday, April 22, 1995

Robert Cushman

BY Robert Cushman THIS is not meant to be a riposte to theatre critic Kate Taylor's review of Into the Woods (When wishes come true, April 8), but I must answer her query about why the Canadian Stage Company should be doing this musical. They should be doing it because it's a masterpiece. And its Canadian premiere is long overdue.
